data.one_liner: Dart client for Supabase Auth API
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart interface to the Supabase Auth (GoTrue) REST API. It handles sign‑up, sign‑in, token refresh, and user management for Supabase projects.
use_when: You need authentication in a Flutter or Dart app that uses Supabase
You want a lightweight client without pulling the full Supabase SDK
You prefer a pure Dart implementation over JavaScript ports
avoid_when: You are already using the full Supabase package and its auth module
You need authentication for a non‑Supabase backend
strengths: Simple, focused API for Supabase Auth
No heavy dependencies, works on all platforms
weaknesses: Only supports Supabase Auth, not other providers
Requires manual integration if you use other Supabase services

alternatives.name: supabase
alternatives.why_pick_it: Unified SDK that includes auth, database, storage, and more
